title: Life Cycle Modeler
role: Explore how survival and reproduction at different life stages change the future of a population.
description: An interactive life-history and demography tool for comparing growth, decline, vulnerability, and persistence.

api.notes: A shared browser and node-consumable API module now exists for the first population-genetics remediation family.

tests.notes: A node-based contract test suite now exercises the shared family API module.

provenance.summary: Public evo-edu framing over the legacy popdyn implementation.
provenance.details: Life Cycle Modeler is the evo-edu public route for the popdyn matrix-population model family. The remediation pass now includes a direct responsive workbench using the shared population-genetics API while preserving the older popdyn route as a legacy reference.
lineage: Public evo-edu route: Life Cycle Modeler
limits: The new public workbench uses the shared population-genetics API rather than the older embedded route.
The older popdyn route remains available as a legacy reference.
Additional work is still needed to expand test coverage and richer scenario presets.
